component.name: SpaceSweep
component.summary: Find duplicate files, clear app caches and empty the trash

description.p: SpaceSweep frees up disk space without guesswork: it finds duplicate, junk and large files in your Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Music, Pictures and Videos folders, lists every folder in ~/.cache by size to clear, and empties the desktop trash.
Everything runs on your computer: no ads, no tracking, no network access.
